### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: When detailing symptom onset or sequence, strictly adhere to the patient's explicit statements regarding timing and preceding events; do not infer temporal relationships for symptoms.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Limit assessment statements to direct diagnoses, explicit provider interpretations, or findings directly linked by the provider; do not infer causality or contributing factors for observations.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Do not infer the likelihood or certainty of a diagnosis or condition unless explicitly stated by the provider.
